text:
Mia Chen: Quick sync — we need a decision on audit telemetry retention vs full-evidence retention for enterprise customers asking for long legal hold windows (5-7 years). Storage cost projection is ballooning if we keep full indices. Thoughts?

Raj Patel: short answer: tiered retention + index pruning. Keep full logs for 90d, indexed metadata for 2 years, cold blob for 7 years. For e-discovery we can rehydrate. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Olivia Ruiz: Legal note: rehydration is acceptable only if chain-of-custody + immutability is preserved. Sampling is NOT acceptable for legal holds or SOC2 evidence requests. Sampling ok for internal analytics but not as a substitute for retention.

Samir Kapoor: Technically we can support tiered retention but rehydration latency will be minutes-hours depending on size. Also searchability after colding requires a restore pipeline. Estimated infra delta: +0.15 USD/active-user-month for 7y cold retention; full indexing for 7y is ~+0.9 USD.

Mia Chen: Can we craft a policy matrix that maps customer tier -> retention profile? e.g., Free/Trial: 90d hot, 1y metadata; Standard: 1y hot + 3y cold; Enterprise: customizable with BYOK + 7y cold.

Raj Patel: Yep. Proposal snippet (config prototype):
```yaml
retention_profiles:
  trial:
    hot_days: 90
    metadata_years: 1
    cold_years: 0
  standard:
    hot_days: 365
    metadata_years: 1
    cold_years: 3
  enterprise:
    hot_days: 365
    metadata_years: 2
    cold_years: 7
    byok_required: true
```

Olivia Ruiz: Also add legal_hold flag that prevents deletion and forces immutability and KMS-escrow logging. Example: `legal_hold: true` must override TTL.

AuditBot: [system] Detected retention_policy draft uploaded by Raj Patel — running cost simulation (eta 12m).

Samir Kapoor: Operational checklist: rehydrate playbook, restore SLAs (target 4h for subseted search, 24h for full restore), indexing budget, KMS key rotation compatibility. Need signoff from Security + Legal.

Mia Chen: Decision ask for tomorrow's roadmap sync: pick default standard profile and enterprise opt-in with BYOK + legal hold controls. Anyone object? @Olivia Ruiz @Samir Kapoor

Olivia Ruiz: No objection. We need the legal_hold override documented in the SOC2 evidence playbook before launch.

Raj Patel: I'll drop a short RFC with cost numbers and the YAML snippet into #product-docs by EOD.

Mia Chen: Great — thanks all. I'll put this on the roadmap as "Retention profiles + legal_hold enforcement" with checkbox: BYOK integration + rehydration runbooks. :white_check_mark:
